Style gallery

Source: vignettes/articles/gallery.Rmd
gallery.Rmd

Each style below sets the same short document. The left page shows the title at the top of page 1. The right page shows a separate title page. The two thesis styles show their title page and first chapter, and the review style its first page and a body page. Click a page to open the PDF.

The specimen is a short note on divorce and net worth, using the public 2022 Survey of Consumer Finances. Its data and statistical tests are real, but its analysis and prose were generated by an AI model and have not been vetted. It is there to show the styles, not as a finding.

American Journal of Sociology ajs

academic set · one column · XITS

Title on page 1Title page

Modelled on the American Journal of Sociology: a centred title and headings, a small-caps byline, footnotes and no colour.

output:
  docdesigner::pdf:
    style: ajs
    title_layout: header   # or page

Demography demography

academic set · one column · EB Garamond

Title on page 1Title page

Modelled on social-demography journals: EB Garamond with oldstyle figures, small-caps section headings and near-black ink.

    title_layout: header   # or page

Methods methods

academic set · one column · Source Serif 4

Title on page 1Title page

Queens College thesis qc-thesis

academic set · one column · XITS

Title pageFirst chapter

The thesis style with the Queens College title page for the MA in Data Analytics and Applied Social Research, including a committee signature block.

toc: true
output:
  docdesigner::pdf:
    style: qc-thesis

Review review

academic set · one column · Source Serif 4

Page 1: the mapA body page

For drafts printed to read and mark up by hand: a 3in writing margin, line and paragraph numbers, a map of the argument, margin flags and changebars.

output:
  docdesigner::pdf:
    style: review
    changes_since: v1.0   # optional: a tag, commit or file

Thesis thesis

academic set · one column · XITS

Title pageFirst chapter

A thesis or dissertation: double-spaced Times-like type, a 1.5-inch binding margin, chapters on new pages, and a title page with an optional signature block.
